desc: 墨黑香槟金版面，藏蓝条纹可拆洗方形深腔宠物窝，十一镜从痛点到收口
leaf: 藏蓝条纹可拆洗方形深腔宠物窝
name: 夜色黑金藏蓝条纹深窝款

shots.intent: 首屏用墨黑加香槟金的影院质感把一只布窝抬成轻奢寝具，一眼建立品质预期并给出三条核心主张
shots.textZone: 上部居中主标题带，其下一行三枚等宽主张标签位，产品下方留空

shots.intent: 把没睡好带来的日常摩擦拆成三格可自我代入的表现，制造换窝的解决需求
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一行短副标题位，三枚卡底各一枚金带标签位

shots.intent: 用六枚六角徽章把睡好这件事的好处排成一串可视清单，承接痛点给出理由
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一行副标题位，六枚六角徽内各一枚标签位

shots.intent: 四宫格把结构卖点逐条落到看得见的部位上，用可见做工替代形容词堆叠
shots.textZone: 四张卡左半各一枚数字牌、一枚标题位与一行短描述位

shots.intent: 一张低角度特写把口沿走线、转角受力和侧边织标拍实，替掉空口的质量承诺
shots.textZone: 左上两行短标签位，其余留空给细节

shots.intent: 把外层面料与内芯填充拆成左右两栏微距对照，用看得见的材质质感支撑耐用与透气的主张
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与副标题位，两栏交界各一枚圆形单字徽与一行标签位

shots.intent: 用一轮发光弯月与星点把安睡这件事情绪化，给整页一个呼吸点并强化睡眠主张
shots.textZone: 产品下方一行主副标题位

shots.intent: 把窝放回真实家里的夜晚一角，让买家想象自家宠物就在这里睡下，补齐场景覆盖
把几档规格放进同一个俯视场并用真实比例差对比，替买家自己判断该选哪一档
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带，每档下方一枚尺寸引线占位与一行适用标签位

shots.intent: 用一张干净的中性参数表消除最后的规格疑虑，替掉源图带会员贴片与二维码的促销层
shots.textZone: 卡片四行规格标签与占位值，行距均匀，卡片上方主标题带

shots.intent: 收口用仰视气势把窝拍成主子的一件寝具，用金箔横幅给一个低摩擦的下单动作
shots.textZone: 上半区香槟金箔横幅主标题带与一行副标题位，下方一枚圆角胶囊按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal-black seamless sweep #141210 carrying one faint vertical light column behind the product, used on every narrative screen; the two material story screens switch to a flat warm ivory-white field #F6F3EC with charcoal text #2D2D2D; one night-sky screen uses a black field with a single glowing crescent disc; one panel treatment per screen, never a third background language and never a mixed light and dark split inside one screen
style.iconSystem: champagne hexagon badges, three filled in the gradient #EFDDA6 to #C9A24A and the rest outline-only in #C9A24A, all of one size and stroke; solid circular chips with one Chinese character slot; a rectangular champagne foil banner plate with dark #141210 type; hairline leader lines in #C9A24A ending in a small solid dot; two soft-focus paw-print glints at low opacity as the only ambient motif; one flat two-tone sleeping-puppy pictogram used on the night screen only
style.lightingSystem: cinematic narrow champagne key from the upper right at 3400K with a soft gold rim tracing the rim edge, plus a broad low-output neutral fill at 5500K so the woven stripe and the navy shell keep their true color; deep falloff into black, low ambient, controlled speculars only on the foil elements, and always a real pooled contact shadow under the base so the bed reads as resting on the ground
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent noir champagne-gold pet-home ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of charcoal-black panel #141210, warm ivory-white panel #F6F3EC, champagne gold accent #C9A24A, bright gold highlight #EFDDA6 and ivory type #F2EFE6 with #2D2D2D used as the dark text tone on ivory screens; warm cinematic tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family for Chinese and Latin, headline 28-42pt, label 14-18pt, all rendered copy as 「」 placeholders, no letter-spaced Latin filler; background system of a matte charcoal-black seamless sweep with one faint vertical light column, reserving flat ivory-white #F6F3EC for the two material story screens and a black night field with one glowing crescent disc for the sleep-mood screen, one treatment per screen; narrow champagne key light from the upper right at 3400K with a soft gold rim plus a broad neutral fill at 5500K, deep falloff to black, controlled speculars only on foil elements, always a real pooled contact shadow under the product; surfaces of matte black sweep, a pale ivory plinth slab with fine mineral grain, and the product's own brushed cotton shell and striped cushion as macro surfaces; infographic components limited to hexagon badges in one size and stroke, three filled in the #EFDDA6 to #C9A24A gradient and the rest outlined in #C9A24A, solid circular single-character chips, a rectangular champagne foil banner plate with #141210 type, hairline leader lines in #C9A24A ending in a small solid dot, two low-opacity paw-print glints as the only ambient motif, and one flat two-tone sleeping-puppy pictogram on the night screen only; product held at a stable slight 3/4 angle and consistent scale with its navy shell, striped cushion, bolster pillow and woven side tab unchanged and never relocated, grounded by its own contact shadow, never floating; any animal cropped at the frame edge or turned away so no individual identity reads; 12px corner radius wherever a card is used; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no unfilled placeholder boxes, no repeated badge copy, no QR codes or store badges, no 3D clip-art arrows.
noDrift: no garbled Latin filler sentences or keyword-stuffed ghost caption lines
no unfilled white or grey placeholder boxes and no leader lines pointing into empty space
no repeated identical caption text inside a numbered badge series
no QR codes, membership patches or store promotion overlays
no glossy 3D clip-art arrows, no star-field stock render overlays
no breed-identifiable animals, no human faces, no human hands
style.presentationRules: the bed holds one stable slight 3/4 hero angle and a constant scale across screens, opening facing the camera, its navy shell, striped cushion, bolster pillow and small woven side tab kept exactly as referenced and never relocated; the product is always grounded by its own contact shadow and never floats; any animal is cropped at the frame edge or turned away so no individual reads as identifiable; card corners fixed at 12px
style.surfaceSystem: matte black studio sweep, a pale ivory plinth slab with a fine mineral grain for the hero and variant screens, the product's own brushed cotton shell and striped cushion as the macro surfaces; no glossy marble, no reflective acrylic, no mirrored floor
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for Chinese and Latin; Chinese headline 28-42pt in the champagne gradient, body label 14-18pt in #F2EFE6 on black and #2D2D2D on ivory; card title 22-26pt; every rendered string carried as a 「」 placeholder, at most one headline and four labels per screen, no letter-spaced Latin filler sentences
